SearchFormDefinition.name: SearchDefForecastItem
SearchFormDefinition.Source: select im from Item im left outer join im.categories cat

Text.name: cfgName
Text.Expression: exists (select 1 from FunctionalGroup fg left join fg.functionalGroupItems item where item=im and lower(fg.name) like lower(:cfgName))

Text.name: categoryName
Text.Expression: case when exists(select 1 from im.categories cat where lower(cat.categoryName) like lower(:categoryName)) then 1 when not exists (select 1 from im.categories cat) and 'n/a' like lower(:categoryName) then 1 else 0 end = 1

MultiText.name: categoryNames
MultiText.Expression: case when exists(select 1 from im.categories cat where lower(cat.categoryName) in (:categoryNames)) then 1 when not exists (select 1 from im.categories cat) and 'n/a' in (:categoryNames) or 'N/A' in (:categoryNames) then 1 else 0 end = 1

List.name: isAssigned
List.Expression: case when :owner is null and :user is null and {VALUE} (select 1 from ItemAssignment where item = im) then 1 when :owner is not null or :user is not null then 1 else 0 end = 1

List.name: owner
List.Expression: case when (:isAssigned is null or :isAssigned = 'exists') and exists (select 1 from im.assignments a where lower(a.responsibility) like lower(:owner) and (:user is null or lower(a.userId) like lower(:user))) then 1 when :isAssigned = 'not exists' and not exists (select 1 from im.assignments a where lower(a.responsibility) = lower(:owner) and (:user is null or lower(a.userId) like lower(:user))) then 1 else 0 end = 1

List.name: regions
List.Expression: exists (select 1 from im.assignments a left join a.regionalResponsibility rs left join rs.site st where st.siteKey in (:regions))

Text.name: user
Text.Expression: case when :owner is not null then 1 when (:isAssigned is null or :isAssigned = 'exists') and exists (select 1 from im.assignments a where lower(a.userId) like lower(:user)) then 1 when :isAssigned = 'not exists' and not exists (select 1 from im.assignments a where lower(a.userId) like lower(:user)) then 1 else 0 end = 1

Text.name: platformName
Text.Expression: exists (select 1 from im.platforms ip where lower(ip.platformName) like lower(:platformName))

List.name: forecastExists
List.Expression: {VALUE} (select 1 from PcmForecast fc where fc.forecastType = :forecastType and fc.item = im)
